title: Gardner venue-booking operations: a Lo-Fi Brewing booking week
description: Walks Chris Gardner through one realistic booking week for a two-space neighborhood venue -- reading a Monday inbox, moving a request forward, holding a date, emailing an offer, double-clicking send, reloading, and confirming a show -- then grades the run against the persona oracles. Ported from extrachill-events/tests/wp-codebox/gardner-venue-booking.json, -seed.php, -journey.php (extrachill-events#771/#292) onto the full 11-site network; every action Gardner takes runs through the real registered abilities. Complements journeys/booking-invariants, which proves the backend invariants (idempotency, concurrency, authorization, conversion) this journey does not re-prove.
